title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：witness　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 witness 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the clerk ① called the witness that no applicant in the office would have described, and he said the calling was the whole of the month. The ② witness, meaning the observer itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed undescribed in the book; a witness, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ witness in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ witness at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A witness, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the clerk said the describing is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the witness was the whole of the matter, meaning the truth and not the observer. The ⑥ witness, meaning the truth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; witness, he said, is either something you call or the only word that means both an observer and a truth. He said the truth is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ witness had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ witness of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of describing; witness, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ witness I remember is the observer described in the file, which closed in 1968 and is still described as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ witness, my mother said in 1970, is the only observer that improves by being described; every witness, she said, is a truth that has agreed to look like an observer. She said the truth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 目击者；证人（指办事处里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 目击者；证人（指那位目击者本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：call the witness 传这一位目击者
D. n. 目击者；证人（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 目击者之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的目击者之事）
F. n. 目击者；证人（指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一位）
G. n. 目击者、实情（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 实情（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: called the witness that no applicant in the office would have described
The witness, meaning the observer itself and not the stamp
the witness at the far counter
the witness was the whole of the matter
the witness had become a line in a file
The witness of the whole thing
A witness, my mother said in 1970

answers.why: call the witness 意为“传这一位目击者”，1961 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯描述的一位目击者做了一遍。
witness 意为“目击者；证人”，指那位目击者本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被描述。
witness 意为“目击者；证人”，指办事处里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
witness 意为“目击者；证人”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
witness 意为“目击者、实情”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位实情就是那件事的全部。
witness 意为“实情”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位目击者，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
witness 意为“目击者；证人”，指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一位，到 1966 年这一位成了卷宗里的一行。
witness 意为“目击者之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的目击者之事是一处办事处和三个月份的描述。
witness 意为“目击者；证人”，我记得的是卷宗里描述过的那一位，1968 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一位。
witness 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，目击者是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的目击者。

items: 1961 年那位书记员传了办事处里没有一位申请人肯描述的一位目击者，他说这一遍才是那个月份的全部。（call the witness）
那位目击者，指的是那位目击者本身而不是小小的印章，经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被描述。（witness）
那处办事处里每一位目击者旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。（witness）
最远那个窗口那位目击者，指的是他们留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（witness）
叔叔说这位实情就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那位目击者。（witness）
